test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The pie chart given below shows the number of students studying in six schools. Total timber of students studying in all these six schools are 4000. Number of students studying in a particular school is shown as a percentage of total number of students studying in all these six schools.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/513df957b89424f2fddb0fd8c8f812e281e1532dfe9c8a361d127047ed5df61d.png] 

What is the difference between the central angle formed by sectors F and H together and the central angle formed by sectors I and G together?
solution:
**Calculation:**

 F and H together is 23 + 16 = 39%

 I and G together is 25 + 18 = 43 %

The difference is 43 - 39 = 4%

As per the question,

100 % = 360° 

So, 4% = 3.6 × 4

⇒ 14.4° 

**∴ The correct option is 2**
